title: 11/18/2026 | Robert & Lyn Pool | COM | Statement in Support of Jay Bradley's Motion requesting disclosure and conditional recusal of Chairman Thomas Gleeson

documents.text:
=== November 17 PUC  Docket.docx ===
November 17, 2026
To the honorable Public Utility Commission of Texas
I am Lyn Pool an affected landowner in Burnet County, Texas, whose property is impacted by proposed Segment H5 of the Bell County East to Big Hill 765kV transmission line project.
I respectfully submit this statement in support of Jay Bradley’s motion in PUC Docket No. 59475 requesting disclosure of information concerning a December 16, 2025 closed-door transmission roundtable involving Chairman Thomas Gleeson and representatives of electric transmission utilities and requesting Chairman Gleeson's recusal if the disclosed facts establish grounds for recusal.
My support is based on the importance of transparency, impartiality and public confidence in the Commission’s decision-making process. 
If Chairman Gleeson say’s that he’s not going to recuse himself then I believe that he should explain why he doesn’t think that it’s necessary.  During all these proceedings we have had to defend our properties to the “Nth” degree and yet the PUCT/ONCOR/ERCOT get away with just saying “No Rehearing” or “No Recusal”.  If we have to have very detailed items in our paperwork then we should be able to ask the same of them.  
I’m going to ask some very simple questions here.
If you were to suspend who you are at the moment and put yourself into our shoes…in other words if this were happening to you wouldn’t you want everything to be open, honest and crystal clear? I am not saying that what you all have done is not honest but this process is far from being open and crystal clear.  
As landowners we have so many questions that so far we have not gotten complete answers to and some questions have been not answered at all.    If everything is on the up and up then why not answer the questions that have been posed?  Why not be open about what actually was said at the meeting with commissioner Gleeson?  If there is nothing to hide then bring everything out in the open. Because we continue to be thwarted at almost everything we ask, we have no choice to consider that something nefarious is going on.   
Please extend to us the considerations that you would want if you were in our shoes. 
We as landowners are being asked to Trust that you will do the right things but if you aren’t complete transparent about what is going on then it very hard to trust.  Trust is earned and so far you all have not earned it yet. 
Grant a rehearing, give the notes and messages that took place at the meeting in December of 2025.  
I have said it before but it bears repeating…the first word in your work is Public….the public is imploring you to do the right thing.  Hold everyone to the same standard as you are holding us to.     
Sincerely,
Lyn Pool
Burnet County, Texas
